# DESIGN.md CLI

This is the unmodified DESIGN.md CLI 0.4.1 built from the upstream release commit. It includes Zod 4.6.7 in the executable. The registry still listed 0.4.0 when this package was built.

[Upstream release commit](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md/commit/05bf717bd30e4ba7eebdc6533a59a6fa41b52f16) · [Upstream dependency fix](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md/pull/185) · [Apache 2.0 license](google-design.md-LICENSE)

The archive was built with Bun 1.3.11. Run bun install with a frozen lockfile and scripts disabled at the upstream root. In packages/cli, run bun run build followed by npm pack with scripts disabled.

SHA-256 `e77ec1b14490af259a5732bfd838287547776aed7c13858cfc1edef4d0070a5e`.
